articles.title: Murder FIR on 10-yr-old girl for pushing toddler from sixth floor in Mumbai
articles.summary: An 18-month-old toddler fell to her death from a sixth-floor stairwell in Goregaon. Police registered a murder FIR against her 10-year-old neighbor based on the mother's complaint.

articles.title: Avengers Assemble: From Captain America to Spider-Man, superheroes run wild in France
articles.summary: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs.

articles.title: Harmanpreet Kaur breaks down on live TV, reveals what has changed
articles.summary: Harmanpreet Kaur achieved a remarkable performance by scoring 91 runs against Zimbabwe in a recent T20I. Her innings marked a significant comeback after struggling for form in previous matches.

articles.title: Mother, lover, son kill 13-year-old twins who opposed their relationship
articles.summary: In Badesra village, two twin brothers, Vinay and Vishnu Chaudhary, were found murdered on Tuesday morning. Their mother, Preeti, allegedly conspired with her paramour to kill them due to their opposition to her relationship.

articles.title: Dev Rai founded a nonprofit at 15; it has helped 400 artisans, sold 900 products and mobilised 300 volunteers
articles.summary: At just 15 years old, Dev Rai launched Serving Society Global Foundation, aiming to uplift India's traditional artisans. This growing nonprofit has generated over $15,000 and engaged more than 300 volunteers.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu rain: Schools closed in Chennai and four other districts on October 21; check latest weather updates
articles.summary: Schools in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, Chengalpattu and Ranipet will remain closed on October 21, 2026, following heavy overnight rainfall in Tamil Nadu. Meenambakkam recorded 12 cm of rain, while Nungambakkam received 11 cm.

articles.title: HP Board registration deadline extended for Class 9, 10; correction window to open on November 17
articles.summary: HPBOSE registration 2026-27: The Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education has set November 16, 2026, as the deadline for Class 9 and Class 10 registration for the 2026-27 academic session, with a late fee of Rs 500. A correction window will remain open from November 17 to November 25 for changes to student details and elective subjects.

articles.title: MPPSC ADPO admit card 2026 to be released today at mppsc.mp.gov.in; check download steps and exam date
articles.summary: MPPSC ADPO admit card 2026: MPPSC ADPO admit card 2026 is scheduled for release on October 21, ahead of the revised written examination on November 1. The recruitment covers 107 Gazetted Class II vacancies under the Madhya Pradesh Home Department.

articles.title: CA Foundation and Inter result dates 2026: Latest update on September exam results
articles.summary: CA Foundation result date 2026: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is expected to announce the CA Intermediate September 2026 results by the evening of October 22, 2026, according to its October 14 announcement. The CA Foundation September 2026 results are expected between October 23 and October 26, although the official date is yet to be confirmed.

articles.title: Kareena taunts Saif over Vicky's romantic posts for Katrina - WATCH
articles.summary: Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan appeared on The Great Indian Kapil Sharma Show where they discussed their relationship. During the show, they addressed social media challenges and public declarations of love.

articles.title: A$AP Rocky says home is ‘hell’ after revealing Rihanna is back in the studio
articles.summary: In a playful moment, A$AP Rocky disclosed that Rihanna is busy in the studio working on new music, warning of possible home consequences for sharing this scoop during a gala. He mentioned in an interview that she's actively writing new material.

articles.title: Jafaar Jackson talks about the ‘Michael’ sequel and who Michael Jackson was
articles.summary: Jaafar Jackson opens up about the high public expectations and controversies linked to his uncle, Michael Jackson, in the upcoming sequel. He stresses the significance of celebrating Michael via his remarkable music and generous deeds.

articles.title: 'Nayyi Navelli' Day 5: India net hits Rs 4.35 cr; worldwide gross nears Rs 24.68 cr
articles.summary: Nayyi Navelli has made a remarkable jump in box office earnings, raking in Rs 4.35 crore on its fifth day in theaters, reflecting a substantial 64.2% increase from the previous day. After five days, its domestic net collection totals Rs 18.65 crore.
